ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising approximately 85% of the surface, contrasted with high-intensity (white) mottling across the remaining 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixel clusters are localized primarily on the distal tips of both lobes and along the superior trailing edge margins. The central fluke body and basal regions maintain a contiguous low-intensity dark profile.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2 and 10 pixels along the entire boundary. A distinct, deeper indentation is visible on the outer third of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by an initial convexity originating from the median notch, transitioning into a concave sweep toward the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters indicative of scarring are visible on the distal tip of the right lobe and along the upper margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several thin, near-vertical high-contrast linear tracks visible on the surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white pigmentation scarring at both distal tips and substantial irregular erosion/jaggedness along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
